Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Search does not always return products that match the query, selected category, or budget, and some browseable products are missing from search. Positive records indicate relevant suggestions and effective search filters can help customers find products quickly.
Feature_Request_Summary: Improve query and filter accuracy, respect budget and category constraints, and ensure category products are indexed and discoverable.
Recommended_Action: Audit search indexing and ranking against representative queries, then add automated tests for budget, category, and combined product-attribute filters.

Main_Theme: Preserving search state when returning to results
Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Returning from a product page clears the search query and filters, forcing customers to repeat their search.
Feature_Request_Summary: Preserve the search query and applied filters when customers return from a product page.
Recommended_Action: Persist search state across product-page navigation and restore it when customers return to results.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Customers must open multiple tabs to compare products, making product evaluation cumbersome.
Feature_Request_Summary: Add a product comparison option directly to search results.
Recommended_Action: Prototype a compare control on search result cards that lets customers select products and review their key attributes side by side.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Customers lack clear, reliable product details: specifications can conflict, size guidance may be missing, and warranty information can be difficult to find.
Feature_Request_Summary: Show consistent specifications, add size charts where relevant, and make warranty duration prominent on product pages.
Recommended_Action: Introduce product-page content checks for conflicting specifications and standardize prominent placement of size guidance and warranty details.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Reviews can be difficult to trust or compare when they appear under the wrong product model or lack useful verification and sorting controls.
Feature_Request_Summary: Associate reviews with the correct product model, add verified-purchase badges, and allow sorting by most recent.
Recommended_Action: Validate review-to-variant associations and add verified-purchase labels and a most-recent sort option to product review pages.

Main_Theme: Positive product performance and build quality
Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: No customer problem was reported; the record reflects a positive product performance and build-quality experience.
Recommended_Action: Share this positive product-quality feedback with the relevant merchandising team and monitor for similar feedback.

Main_Theme: Availability of larger product pack sizes
Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: The customer wants a larger pack size of a product that is otherwise part of a positive experience.
Feature_Request_Summary: Offer GlowCare Daily Moisturizer in a larger pack size.
Recommended_Action: Ask the category team to assess demand and sourcing feasibility for a larger GlowCare Daily Moisturizer pack.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Failed or declined payments can prevent checkout and leave customers uncertain about whether an order was placed or funds were debited; one customer reported a smooth payment experience.
Feature_Request_Summary: Provide clear, timely payment and order status after failures, including guidance for possible duplicate debits.
Recommended_Action: Add a payment-failure recovery flow that confirms order status, explains pending or duplicate debit handling, and offers a clear retry path.

Main_Theme: Reducing checkout entry and account friction
Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Checkout creates unnecessary effort by requiring customers to re-enter saved addresses or create an account for a one-time purchase.
Feature_Request_Summary: Automatically use saved addresses and offer guest checkout.
Recommended_Action: Streamline checkout to prefill saved addresses for signed-in customers and provide a guest purchase path.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Customers cannot reliably see the full order cost early enough, and promo-code application may not be reflected in the displayed total.
Feature_Request_Summary: Show the delivery fee before checkout begins and update the order total accurately when a promo code is applied.
Recommended_Action: Display an itemized total, including delivery fees and applied discounts, before checkout and recalculate it immediately when promotions change.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Repeat purchases require too many checkout steps.
Feature_Request_Summary: Add a one-click reorder option for products the customer buys regularly.
Recommended_Action: Add a reorder action to order history that preloads a previous purchase into checkout for customer review.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Tracking can be stale, inaccurate, or inconsistent with the actual delivery, while delays and changing estimates leave customers unsure when to expect their parcel.
Feature_Request_Summary: Provide accurate tracking and delivery confirmations, explain delays, notify customers about stalled tracking, and show a reliable updated delivery date.
Recommended_Action: Create delivery-status quality rules that flag stalled scans, verify delivery confirmations, and trigger customer updates with an explanation and revised ETA when plans change.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: No customer problem was reported; the parcel arrived early and was carefully packaged.
Recommended_Action: Share this positive delivery and packaging feedback with the operations team as an example of a successful customer experience.

Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: Customers who are away during the day may miss deliveries because they cannot choose a suitable delivery time.
Feature_Request_Summary: Allow customers to choose a delivery time slot.
Recommended_Action: Assess carrier and fulfillment support for offering selectable delivery windows during checkout or through order management.

Main_Theme: Protecting parcels at the delivery location
Customer_Pain_Point_Summary: A parcel was left exposed to rain outside the apartment gate, risking damage to the package and its contents.
Feature_Request_Summary: Allow delivery instructions for sheltered placement or otherwise protect parcels from rain.
Recommended_Action: Add a delivery-instructions field for safe, sheltered drop-off preferences and make it visible to delivery partners.
